Hi Anika —

Sorry to hear about the spike, and thanks for flagging it. We can help on two fronts: immediate burst capacity to keep traffic healthy, and a short-term commercial concession while you finalize a Q2 commitment.

Immediate (operational):
- We can enable a temporary elastic quota for 72 hours capped at 20M tokens for your us-west region. This will prevent throttling and route excess to Dedicated burst nodes.
- Activation is immediate from our side but requires a written confirmation from BrightLoan to proceed.

Commercial options:
1) One-off incident credit: we can offer a $6k credit applied to the March invoice for this incident if you sign a Q2 committed reservation (3 months minimum) before 2027-03-22.
2) Pro-rated commit: convert the expected overrun into a pro-rated committed capacity for March–May with a 15% committed discount and a capped overage rate of $0.045 per 1k tokens above commit.

I’ve attached an updated pricing sheet and a short term term-sheet describing both options. If you want me to activate the 72-hour elastic quota now, reply with approval and I’ll loop infra to enable it.

—
Soojin Lee
